Year 1: First Year

Two semesters. Each subject is split into short chapters you can finish in one sitting.

  • Semester 1

    Foundations of Nursing

    Anatomy, physiology, psychology, sociology and basic nursing care.

    6 subjects·54 chapters
  • Semester 2

    Basic Sciences & Nursing Foundation

    Biochemistry, nutrition, nursing procedures and health informatics.

    4 subjects·47 chapters
